scope: Selected significant magic and cross-mod systems from TMM 1.21.1 NeoForge manifest and mod comprehension index. Not an assertion of all currently loadable JARs. Planned/excluded mods are not auto-covered.

contract.primary_role: Primary mod classification is a documentation default / audit bucket, NOT blanket mutation or grant to every recipe, world tick, entity and cast.
evaluation_order: identify actual server-authoritative player-committed use/event and installed mod/version
if explicit source spell school exists use that exact ID (Iron school above all thematic guesses)
if a specific action/item/ritual has an explicitly verified typed blood or nature effect override its parent mod default
otherwise use the primary mod default only for directly player-attributed eligible magic actions
world machines, passive automation, transfer, decorative blocks, crafting inputs, pet AI and fixed loot are not magic-spell strength events
if cross-mod adapter inherits parent school it must NOT double-trigger modifiers or MXP

semantics.Nature: Nature-themed spells, druidic/wild/fae life magic and personally attributed plant/animal/forest effects; subject to werewolf nature bonus and lich nature penalty only for actual eligible effects.
semantics.Blood: Explicit blood/EV/life-as-power player magic and named Blood spell-school effects; subject to lich blood boost. A blood-colored animation, an injured caster or a soul sacrifice alone does NOT suffice.
semantics.Other: Arcane, elemental, stellar, soul, necromancy, demon/occult, technological and nonclassified magic. Other is NOT a synonym for unusable: it may carry independent `demonic`, `fae`, `sea_storm`, `necromancy` and similar class subtypes.

contract.source_priority: Exact pinned source IDs > explicit spell-school IDs > validated event-specific action tags > approved mod-level default for eligible player spells > unknown/held. A mod-wide theme never overrides a source spell's own classification.
contract.eligible_only: Source-authenticated player cast, item active ability, empowered personal attack, controlled summon, or explicit manually activated ritual after real resource payment. No blanket automation/machine/loot multiplier.

forest_dragon.supplement: Nature ecology utilities have separate policies

sea_dragon.supplement: Independent of Nature/Blood; source-backed classification required

mixed_overrides.apply: all committed player Blood-school spell casts
all committed player Nature-school spell casts
only actual blood-consumption / blood-powered effects, not becoming vampire itself

unresolved_high_priority: Pinned Iron and addon school custom ID registry check
JAWR 0.5.39 effect IDs: nature/blood/other breakdown, actual spell debit and native physiology ownership
EvilCraft which player-held blood items trigger a personal power hook vs only machinery
Neo Vitae Anima, EV, Sigils, Spiritus: distinct player action tags and no buff to passive altar production
Botania Revived player-item mana use versus automated mana flower and spreader
Roots Classic named spells rather than generic Roots 4 API

Forge/NeoForge Luck, chance and loot attribute consumers need separate audit

mods.name: Neo Vitae
mods.guardrails: The Ara Vitae altar, EV pipes, tanks and passive automation remain excluded from personal spell-power buffs.

mods.name: EvilCraft
mods.theme: blood-powered rituals and devices; vengeance spirits
mods.guardrails: Blood Infuser, Spirit Furnace, Purifier and other machine throughput are not player spell-casts; vengeance spirit techniques require subtyping.

mods.name: Botania Revived
mods.guardrails: Exclude mana generating flowers, spreaders, pools, runic altars, automated producers, Gaia Guardian reward drops.

mods.name: Extra Botany Revived
mods.guardrails: Do not assume every addon armor stat or item action is a nature spell; confirm event and owner.

mods.name: Roots Classic
mods.guardrails: This is ROOTS CLASSIC, not Roots 4; avoid source/mana APIs from the other project.

mods.name: Feywild
mods.theme: fey magic, seasons and fae summons
mods.guardrails: Fey creature identity alone does not convert every mob attack, quest, or automatic activity into player-cast Nature magic.

mods.name: Totemic / Fenn's Totemic
mods.guardrails: Check exact pinned Fenn's fork mechanics; do not buff passive world totems/machines blindly.

mods.name: Iron's Spells 'n Spellbooks
mods.theme: multi-school spells; explicit BLOOD and NATURE schools
mods.guardrails: `irons_spellbooks:blood` -> Blood, `irons_spellbooks:nature` -> Nature, all other registered schools -> Other. School ID rather than spell display name.

mods.name: Just Another Witchery Remake (JAWR)
mods.theme: witchcraft mix: blood/vampirism, herbalism and rites
mods.guardrails: Source-check blood/vampire actions -> Blood; confirmed plant/herb/growth personally cast spells -> Nature; other curses, sigils and generic ritual magic -> Other.

mods.name: Enchanted: Witchcraft
mods.theme: herbal witchcraft, circle rites, brewing and poppets
mods.guardrails: Herbology, grow/herb effects may be Nature; curses/poppetry remain Other unless explicit blood mechanics. Brewing ingredients alone are not enough.

mods.name: Hexerei
mods.guardrails: Herbal content is a Nature candidate only when a source-verified effect actually expresses nature magic; cauldron crafting not automatically a spell.

mods.name: Primal Magick
mods.theme: multiple primal sources; elemental research and spells
mods.guardrails: Use actual source/aspect identity; flora/life/earth themed spells may be Nature when verified, generic elemental/arcane effects Other.

mods.name: Ars Nouveau
mods.theme: programmable multiglyph personal spells and source automation
mods.guardrails: Nature-tagged growth/plant outcomes only if explicitly classified; spells are not wholesale Nature because Archwood exists. No machine automation buff.

mods.name: Ars Elemental
mods.guardrails: Elemental is not automatically Nature; verify actual school/element tag per spell; water/ice/storm are Other with Sea Dragon sub-affinity.

mods.name: Astral Sorcery
mods.guardrails: Cosmic/starlight magic is not automatically Nature even if nighttime/outdoors; multiblock starlight altar is excluded from personal spell-power buffs.

mods.name: Eidolon: Repraised
mods.theme: soul shards, necromancy, theurgy, ritual and artifice
mods.guardrails: Sacrifice, undead and soul shards do not automatically mean Blood. Require explicit blood-as-resource action for any Blood override.

mods.name: Goety: The Dark Arts
mods.theme: soul-energy magic, minions, curses and necromancy
mods.guardrails: Soul energy is not blood. Cave Dragon demonic affinity is a separate secondary tag, not the Blood primary category.

mods.name: Goety Cataclysm
mods.theme: Goety addon focused on Cataclysm servants and focus effects
mods.guardrails: Do not buff all Cataclysm bosses just because a Goety add-on references them.

mods.name: Occultism
mods.guardrails: Blood-like sacrifices do not by themselves make spells Blood. Cave Dragon demonic affinity can key off a separate tagged source.

mods.name: Malum
mods.theme: spirit arcana, soul and totem magic
mods.guardrails: Spirit and blight are not Blood; Runewood trees are not sufficient to make the whole mod Nature.

mods.name: Gaze (Malum addon)
mods.guardrails: Inherit Malum source context; no assumed blood tag.

mods.name: JAWR: Forbidden Magic
mods.guardrails: Soul magic and lichdom are not automatically Blood; some explicit lifeblood effects require a per-action secondary Blood classification.

mods.name: Forbidden & Arcanus
mods.theme: Aureal, magical artifacts and occult elements
mods.guardrails: Do not map souls/occult aesthetics to Blood without actual blood-powered effects.

mods.name: HexCast NEOFORGED
mods.guardrails: Pattern outcome might be Nature-like; never classify solely by the port's media/amethyst cost.

mods.name: Psi
mods.guardrails: A construct that makes crops grow isn't necessarily tagged nature until a verified spell effect is classified.

mods.name: Psi: Tweaks and Additions
mods.guardrails: Exclude industrial Psionic Generator and energy conversion loops from nature/blood personal magic.

mods.name: Mahou Tsukai
mods.theme: special effects, spell circles and personal mana
mods.guardrails: Some spells have sacrifice/HP themes; require actual blood power debit to tag Blood; do not tag all circles.

mods.name: Pastel
mods.guardrails: Color and natural energy aesthetics are not enough to classify as Nature.

mods.name: Scriptor Magicae
mods.guardrails: Default Other until explicit typed Nature/Blood action, not based on ingredient words.

mods.name: Theurgy
mods.guardrails: Machinery, sulfur processing and item duplication are not player Blood/Nature spells.

mods.name: Embers Re-Ignited
mods.guardrails: Exclude production throughput unless separate crafting trait explicitly authorized.

mods.name: Ars Additions
mods.guardrails: Classify by final effective Ars glyph/cast, not addon package.

mods.name: Ars Controle
mods.guardrails: Controller/item mechanics by concrete event; do not award bonus twice.

mods.name: Ars Elemancy
mods.guardrails: Elemental school defaults Other; classify confirmed nature glyph per source.

mods.name: Ars Ocultas
mods.guardrails: Jarred mobs and sacrificial ritual components do not by themselves make the result Blood; tag effect based on resource/owner.

mods.name: Ars Unification
mods.guardrails: Bridge must not count the same spell twice.

mods.name: Ars 'n Spells
mods.theme: Ars Nouveau and Iron's spells interoperability
mods.guardrails: Use Iron Blood/Nature registered school for Iron spells; classify Ars glyph spells by verified context. Cross-cast must only get one affinity.

mods.name: Summoning Rituals
mods.theme: data-driven ritual framework, not a school
mods.guardrails: No automatic Nature or Blood from recipes requiring herbs, skulls, blood drops, or animals; classify actual effect and consumed power source.

mods.name: ProjectE
mods.theme: transmutation/EMC economy, not personal cast school
mods.guardrails: No class affinity buff to EMC machines or progression-gated items.

mods.name: Draconic Evolution
mods.theme: FE power systems, gear and Chaos Guardian
mods.guardrails: Tech gear matters to Monk-versus-equipped-specialist balance; not a personal Nature/Blood magic school.
